title: Manager/Senior Manager, Manufacturing Investigations
text:
**Job summary**
---------------

The Manager/Senior Manager, Manufacturing Investigations, position is strategically intended to support continuous process improvement by developing and leading a team of investigators in analyzing cross-functional non-conformance events (“Deviations”), defining root cause, assessing product impact, and implementing Corrective/ Preventive actions. The Manager should possess proven technical writing and problem-solving skills as well as a desire for developing investigators in the art of problem-solving analysis. This is a direct supervisor position also responsible for the training and development of the investigators as well as for their overall performance. An understanding of Biotechnology Upstream, Downstream, and Support principles with experience in non-conformance management is ideal.

**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------

* The Manager is responsible for oversight of the Manufacturing Operations’ deviation performance. The incumbent is responsible for the assignment of the deviations, ensuring departmental deviation ownership is balanced and appropriately distributed to facilitate timely and quality closure.
* Train and mentor a team of investigators to conduct comprehensive investigations to determine root cause, product impact and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Methodically investigate and troubleshoot Manufacturing deviations using defined troubleshooting and investigational techniques. Develop and implement preventive actions to reduce the potential of recurrence or proactively prevent the occurrence of a new deviation.
* Ensure non-conformance investigations meet or exceed the rigor of internal, client and regulatory reviewers.

**Minimum Requirements**
------------------------

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

Manager:

* BA/BS Degree in a science field preferred (i.e., Biology, Microbiology, Chemistry, Pharmacy, etc.) or equivalent combination of education and experience; 8+ years of pharmaceutical or related work experience with emphasis on current Good Manufacturing Practices including QA, QC, Validation, Manufacturing, or Process Engineering.

Sr. Manager

* BA/BS Degree in a science field preferred (i.e., Biology, Microbiology, Chemistry, Pharmacy, etc.) or equivalent combination of education and experience; 10+ years of pharmaceutical or related work experience with emphasis on current Good Manufacturing Practices including QA, QC, Validation, Manufacturing, or Process Engineering; 5+ years of prior leadership/supervisory experience preferred.

Salary Range:

Manager $118,000 - $148,000

Senior Manager: $133,000 - $167,000

Salary range provided per current averages and expectations. The salary and job title for this opening will be based on the selected candidate’s qualifications and experience and may be outside this range. KBI has a robust total rewards strategy which includes an annual bonus structure for all employees, medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid PTO and holidays, 401K matching with 100% vesting in 60 days and employee recognition programs.
